description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-corpus-mdb: CREATE TABLE C ... TEXT(255) WITH COMPRESSION is refused by DAO Database.Execute (3290), so table C was never created and order-sql-mdb and order-index-mdb ended in failures on C. Asks, on a copy of fixture r-sort-3-corpus-mdb (MDB) opened read/write: ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, Data Source set through Connection.Properties) creates C(ID INTEGER primary key, KC TEXT(255) WITH COMPRESSION, KN TEXT(255)) in the closed copy; DAO then fills it from T with INSERT INTO C (ID, KC, KN) SELECT ID, K, K WHERE G is ascii, latin1, han, width or pair (the compressed and the uncompressed copy of one subset) with dbFailOnError, builds IX_KC and IX_KN after the rows, and reads C's fields, the ID sequences of SQL ORDER BY KC and ORDER BY KN, and the IX_KC and IX_KN table-type walks.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE C (ID INTEGER CONSTRAINT PK_C PRIMARY KEY, KC TEXT(255) WITH COMPRESSION, KN TEXT(255))
INSERT INTO C (ID, KC, KN) SELECT ID, K, K FROM T WHERE G IN ('ascii', 'latin1', 'han', 'width', 'pair')
SELECT ID FROM C ORDER BY KC
SELECT ID FROM C ORDER BY KN
